The encoding takes the finding as an input and never computes it. Return of the thing alone is not enough (STJ Tema 1205), and the principle does not apply to domestic violence against women (Súmula 589 STJ).

citations.cite: STF, HC 84.412/SP (Segunda Turma, rel. Min. Celso de Mello, j. 19.10.2004, DJ 19.11.2004)
STJ, Tema repetitivo 1.205, as reported in sweep-b (M-sweep-b-30)
Súmula 589 STJ, as reported in sweep-b (M-sweep-b-30)

readings.description: The encoding decides theft from the words of the article alone; a trivially small taking is still theft, possibly privileged under § 2º.

citations.cite: CP art. 155, caput and § 2º

readings.description: Insignificance is computed: the thing is worth at most 10% of the minimum wage at the time of the fact, and the agent is not a repeat offender.

citations.cite: TJDFT, Acórdão 1659805 — a local parameter, as reported in sweep-b (M-sweep-b-30)

readings.foreclosure: A rule of thumb in some state courts with no statutory basis and no binding authority; the STF's test is qualitative, and a figure would replace the judge's assessment.

taken.rationale: The principle is applied by every court, so leaving it out would give answers the courts do not; computing it would replace the judge. As an input finding it keeps the judgement where the courts put it, and the formal predicates (`furto consumado`, `furto tentado`) still state the text alone.

notes: Reserved id: opened by M-sweep-b-30 as F-sweep-b-21; g0 had first written it as F-g0-22, taking the formal reading and encoding nothing. It follows the sweep's suggested reading now.

source.quote: e a qualificadora for de ordem objetiva

citations.cite: Súmula 511 STJ

readings.description: Abuse of trust (§ 4º, II) and membership of a criminal group (§ 9º) are subjective, being about the agent; every other qualificadora — obstacle, fraud, climbing, sleight of hand, false key, two or more people, the kind of thing, the means — is objective.

citations.cite: CP art. 155, §§ 4º to 10
Súmula 511 STJ

citations.cite: CP art. 155, § 4º, II — "mediante fraude"

citations.cite: CP art. 155, § 4º, IV
CP art. 29 — "Quem, de qualquer modo, concorre para o crime"

readings.description: Everyone who took part counts, the agent included, whether or not each is punishable (a minor, a person not imputable) and whether or not each is identified.

citations.cite: CP art. 29; art. 155, § 4º, IV — "pessoas", not "agentes puníveis"

readings.description: Only those present at the execution count, not an instigator or a helper who stayed away.

site.anchor: as opções do juiz pelo art. 155, § 2º

source.quote: o juiz pode substituir a pena de reclusão pela de detenção, diminuí-la de um a dois terços, ou aplicar somente a pena de multa.

citations.cite: CP art. 155, § 2º

readings.description: Once the requirements are met the judge must grant the privilege, choosing among the three options.

citations.cite: STJ, HC 583.023/SC (j. 4.8.2020), as reported by secondary sources: "Trata-se, em verdade, de direito subjetivo do réu, não configurando mera faculdade do julgador a sua concessão"

readings.description: "O juiz pode": the judge may grant the privilege or not.

citations.cite: CP art. 155, § 2º — "pode"

taken.rationale: Recorded, not built in: the encoding returns the three options when the requirements are met and states neither that one must be granted nor that none may be. It is named `as opções`, not `as faculdades`, so as not to take the rejected side.

notes: A second question sits under the same words: whether two options may be combined (substitution AND reduction). The text joins them with "ou"; the encoding returns the list and leaves the combination to the judge.
The STJ quotation is from a secondary compilation; g3's sweep should confirm it.

site.anchor: a pena cominada com a causa
provisions: every cause whose words name "as penas"

source.quote: As penas aplicam-se cumulativamente e em dobro

citations.cite: CP art. 146, § 1º
CP art. 58 — "A multa, prevista em cada tipo legal de crime, tem os limites fixados no art. 49 e seus parágrafos deste Código."

readings.description: A cause of increase or decrease changes the custodial range only. The fine a preceito prescribes has no number of its own to scale: art. 58 gives every multa art. 49's limits, and the judge fixes the number of dias-multa under arts. 49 and 60.

citations.cite: CP art. 60 — "Na fixação da pena de multa o juiz deve atender, principalmente, à situação econômica do réu."

readings.description: Where the paragraph's words reach the fine as well ("As penas aplicam-se … em dobro", plural, in a paragraph that also makes the fine cumulative), the increase applies to the number of dias-multa too.

citations.cite: CP art. 146, § 1º — "As penas aplicam-se cumulativamente e em dobro"

taken.rationale: For the shared machinery only: `a pena cominada com a causa` and `o intervalo com a causa` scale durations, and `Cominação da multa` is a conjunction, not a number. This does not decide the question for an article whose words reach the fine; PLAN § 2.2.1 hands it to that article's encoder (art. 146 § 1º is g2b's), who takes a reading there. g0 searched no authority on it, so no court's view is claimed either way.

site.anchor: o último dia do prazo em dias
provisions: every period the Code states in days

source.quote: Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum.

citations.cite: CP art. 10

readings.description: A period the Code states in days is that many calendar days, the first day counting: 180 days begun on 5 July 2026 end on 31 December 2026.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum."

readings.description: A period in days is converted at thirty days to the month and counted as calendar months, so 180 days begun on 5 July 2026 end on 4 January 2027. This is what `o último dia do prazo` did when given `dias 180`, before this fork was opened.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 10 counts days, months and years each on the calendar; it converts none into another. The thirty-day month is a convention for taking a FRACTION of a quantity (F-g0-03), and nothing in art. 10 extends it to counting a period. Found by g6b (art. 359-G's 180 days), 2026-09-29.

taken.rationale: `o último dia do prazo em dias` n d counts n calendar days from d, the first day counting, dropping a fraction of a day (art. 11). `Duração` is unchanged, because a second field would break every `Duração WITH` built elsewhere and would make `dias 20 EQUALS meses 2/3`-style assertions false; so a Duração does not remember its unit, and `o último dia do prazo` keeps counting its whole months on the calendar and the remainder as days, byte-identical for every period built from `anos` or `meses`.

notes: Not decided here: a quantity that DOSIMETRY produces in days (fifteen days doubled is thirty) is a Duração, and `o último dia do prazo` counts it as one calendar month. Whether a penalty fixed as 'trinta dias' is served as thirty days or as a month is F-g0-03's question on the other side, and is left open for the executing encoder (g1b/g1c).
witnesses: `o último dia do prazo em dias` 180 (YMD 2026 7 5) against `o último dia do prazo` (dias 180) (YMD 2026 7 5) — 31.12.2026 against 4.1.2027 (cp-g0-pena-testes.l4, § Art. 10)
